subject.title: fix(ui): add timeout to control-ui bootstrap config fetch

question: Should the Control UI adopt a fixed 15-second per-auth-attempt deadline that may replace late server bootstrap metadata with defaults?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility and latency contract for slow reverse proxies or gateways; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the acceptable cutoff or retry scope.

options.title: Accept 15 seconds per attempt
options.body: Keep the patch after actual-app before/after proof shows the blocked operation and confirms fallback behavior for every relevant auth candidate.

options.title: Use one operation budget
options.body: Bound the full bootstrap retry sequence with one deadline if maintainers prefer predictable total startup latency over giving every credential candidate a full window.

options.title: Pause pending reproduction
options.body: Do not merge a new fallback deadline until an unpatched actual Control UI run demonstrates a user-visible blocked operation.

recommendation.title: Accept 15 seconds per attempt
recommendation.body: Keep the patch after actual-app before/after proof shows the blocked operation and confirms fallback behavior for every relevant auth candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the authenticated bootstrap retry path and are the strongest history-backed owner for its latency and fallback contract.
